FAQ

Common questions

Which ERP platforms can ABiT implement?

ABiT works with SAP Business One, Odoo, ERPNext, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Sage, Tally and custom ERP systems. The team also builds integrations and custom modules around these platforms.

Do you support companies outside Pakistan?

Yes. ABiT supports businesses in Pakistan, UAE, Saudi Arabia and worldwide through remote delivery, scheduled workshops and managed support.

Can you improve an existing ERP setup?

Yes. ABiT can audit current configuration, data quality, reports, integrations and user workflows, then prioritize improvements that reduce operational friction.
